usage: 即刻 is an adverb used to indicate that an action happens immediately or without delay.
It can be placed before a verb to emphasize urgency, for example, '即刻走' means 'leave immediately.'
It can appear at the beginning or middle of a sentence depending on the emphasis.
The word 即刻 is commonly used in both formal and informal speech to request promptness or quick response.
It cannot be used as a noun or adjective on its own.
